name: Ricardo Fonseca
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. This early exposure fueled his desire to work within the industry. He pursued a degree in Communications, specializing in public relations, and quickly landed an internship with a small racing team. His knack for crafting compelling narratives and building relationships with the media proved invaluable.

After several years honing his skills, Ricardo joined Sprint V8 Team. He believes in transparency and authenticity, focusing on creating genuine connections between the team, its fans, and sponsors. He is known for his calm demeanor, even under the intense pressure of race weekends, allowing him to effectively manage crises and maintain a positive public image for the team. His dedication to building strong relationships and telling compelling stories sets him apart.

Ricardo is incredibly committed to the success of the team, spending a significant amount of time thinking about how to improve media relations and public sentiment. He's also willing to travel and put in the hours required to fulfill the demands of the role.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a confident and approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters displayed in his office.
Insists on starting every media interview with a positive anecdote about the team.
